Contract CoCoMESystem::closeStore(storeID:Integer): Boolean {
          definition:
          store:Store = Store.allInstance()->any(o | o.Id = storeID)
            
            precondition:
          self.CurrentStore.oclIsUndefined() = bool and self.CurrentStore.IsOpened = true and Store.allInstance()->includes(self.CurrentStore)
            
            postcondition:
          result = store.oclIsNew() and result = true
            
        }
